title: Peer review and credentialing.
bodyText: Peer review activities shall be subject to chapters 663 and 671D and all other provisions and restrictions of medical peer review committees established by state law.
bodyHtml: §323F-10.6  Peer review and credentialing.  Peer review activities shall be subject to chapters 663 and 671D and all other provisions and restrictions of medical peer review committees established by state law. [L 1998, c 229, pt of §1; am L 2007, c 290, §28]
